nameEn: Manufacture of other transport equipment n.e.c.
description: This class includes the manufacture of transport equipment not elsewhere classified.
includes: manufacture of hand-propelled vehicles: wheelbarrows, hand carts, shopping trolleys
manufacture of animal-drawn vehicles: carriages, carts, sleighs
manufacture of stretchers and other patient transportation devices
excludes: manufacture of bicycles and invalid carriages, see 3092
manufacture of children's tricycles and other toys, see 3240
